Reporting & Management Insight

Every module feeds one reporting layer. Real-time dashboards, financial statements, operational reports, and strategic KPIs — all from the same data.

Who this is for

CEOs, directors, department heads, and anyone who needs to see what is happening across the organisation — without waiting for month-end reports or asking someone to run a query.

What you can do

Executive Dashboard

Today's sales, monthly performance with achievement bars, low stock alerts, gross margin, active customers, and 12-month trend charts. The first screen a managing director sees.

Accounting Dashboard

Total assets, liabilities, equity, and net profit at a glance. Current ratio, debt-to-equity, and profit margin with Healthy/Fair/Weak indicators. Trial balance status.

Sales Manager Dashboard

Sales performance by rep, territory, and product. Pipeline visibility. Achievement against targets. Top customers and overdue accounts.

Store Dashboard

Active stores, total stock value, low stock items, inventory by location with utilisation bars, pending transfers, and expiring batches with urgency badges.

Procurement Dashboard

Open purchase requests, open POs, GRNs today, pending invoices, AP total with overdue aging, and quick actions for procurement officers.

KPI Dashboard

Strategic KPIs with targets and actuals. Track performance across financial, customer, internal process, and learning perspectives. Linked to the balanced scorecard.

Compliance Dashboard

Monitor compliance status across the organisation. Track audit findings, corrective actions, and regulatory requirements. Generate compliance reports for boards and regulators.

Financial Statements

Profit and loss, balance sheet, cash flow statement, and trial balance. Departmental and consolidated views. Export to PDF or Excel. Configurable reporting periods.

How it connects

Reporting is not a separate module — it is the lens through which every other module is visible. Every dashboard pulls from the same live data:

  • Accounting → financial statements, budgets, trial balance
  • Sales → sales trends, customer analytics, agent performance
  • Inventory → stock levels, valuation, movement history
  • Procurement → spend analysis, vendor performance, AP aging
  • HR → headcount, payroll costs, leave balances
  • Manufacturing → production efficiency, yield, QC statistics
  • Strategy & BSC → strategic objectives, KPIs, departmental workplans
